text: The semantic tableau method proves that φ is valid by:
choices: deriving φ from the axioms using modus ponens
assuming ¬φ and showing every branch of the resulting tree closes (each contains some ψ and ¬ψ)
constructing a single model in which φ is true
converting φ to CNF and applying resolution until no clauses remain
explanation: Tableaux are refutation-based: to show φ is valid, assume ¬φ and expand; if every branch closes (each holds a formula and its negation), then ¬φ is unsatisfiable and φ is valid. An open branch instead yields a countermodel. Option 1 is a Hilbert proof, option 3 confuses validity with mere satisfiability, and option 4 is resolution.
